asset.name: ErrorRecoveryFlow
asset.description: The failure workflow classifying retryability, preserving user work, exposing safe diagnostics, offering alternatives, and restoring the last known good state.

requires.reason: Rendering failures are contained and resettable.
Failure presentation and recovery affordances are shared.
Retryable failures are distinguished from permanent ones.

rationale: Retryability classification is the load-bearing part: blindly retrying a permanent failure wastes the user's time and hammers the backend, while failing to retry a transient one turns a hiccup into a dead end.
